rationale: The public technical reference supplies a detailed system-dynamics architecture, equations by sector, source bibliography, and calibration discussion under CC BY 4.0.
Climate Interactive separately offers a licensed SDK for software integration.
The reviewed sources do not establish that the full production Vensim model and its complete calibrated parameter set can be copied into this repository under the documentation license.
A clean-room implementation can be transparent, modular, independently testable, and extended to U.S. transmission, health, and water without implying affiliation or numerical identity.

evidence.finding: Software integrations are offered through a licensed SDK.
Public architecture specifies ODE stock-flow structure, Euler integration, timestep, horizon, aggregation, and module organization.
Public supply chapter specifies pathways, capacity pipeline, cost drivers, resources, storage, and investment-choice behavior.
Public demand chapter specifies end uses, carrier choice, and capital-stock framing.
Public calibration chapter identifies calibration datasets and model-comparison families.

prohibited_representations: Do not call the clean-room implementation En-ROADS.
Do not state or imply that Climate Interactive, MIT, or Ventana validated this implementation.
Do not claim numerical equivalence until a documented validation suite demonstrates it, and even then describe only tested outputs and tolerances.
Do not label scenarios as predictions or forecasts.
Do not copy SDK or simulator code without an applicable license.
attribution_template: This model is inspired by and adapts concepts from the En-ROADS Technical Reference by Climate Interactive (CC BY 4.0). It is an independent implementation and is not the En-ROADS simulator.

implementation_contract.runtime: TypeScript module usable from Astro pages and Web Workers

phases.name: Evidence freeze
exit_tests: no unresolved value is silently selected

phases.name: Observed energy baseline
exit_tests: matches cited historical totals within declared tolerance

phases.name: Transmission and storage
exit_tests: queued capacity never treated as operating

phases.name: Climate coupling
exit_tests: scenario comparisons with En-ROADS and established IAM ranges without overfitting

phases.name: Dashboard integration
exit_tests: every chart value traces to evidence or derivation

validation_matrix.question: Does each cited source exist at the recorded canonical URL and match the named publisher/title?
Does the cited locator support the claim with the same scope, unit, geography, period, and status?
Do stocks conserve energy, carbon, capacity, and material where applicable?
Does the model reproduce selected historical series within declared tolerances?
Does the model remain stable and plausible at slider limits and zero/large inputs?
Are output sensitivities traceable to documented causal pathways?
Do results sit within explained ranges from En-ROADS, NEMS/AEO, IEA, NGFS, and IPCC model families?
Can every displayed number be traced to a source observation or a versioned formula?

next_implementation_artifact: A small TypeScript system-dynamics kernel and schema should be built only after the parameter/unit registry and 1990-2025 calibration series are ingested.
